method_notes.plain_fft: No explicit lag alignment; residual channel misalignment can broaden spectral peak.
method_notes.full_xcorr_fft: Full-range lag may pick wrong cycle under periodic ambiguity (less robust than constrained PCCC).
method_notes.norm_xcorr_fft: Normalization helps amplitude drift but still suffers periodic lag ambiguity.
method_notes.welch_periodogram: Window averaging stabilizes frequency but loses resolution if segments are short.
method_notes.autocorr_period: Can lock to harmonic/subharmonic peaks when waveform is distorted or truncated.
method_notes.hilbert_phase: Requires relatively clean narrowband structure; phase unwrap noise can bias slope.
method_notes.sinusoid_ls: Single-tone assumption may be violated by harmonics and segment boundary effects.
method_notes.zero_crossing: Sensitive to noise/phase jitter; sign-flip counts become unstable on non-ideal sinusoidal segments.
